summary: Canoas Air Force Base (Base Aérea de Canoas, BACO) is a Brazilian Air Force (FAB) installation located in the city of Canoas, within the greater Porto Alegre metropolitan area in Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil. The base primarily supports military aviation operations and is situated near the region's main civilian airport, Salgado Filho International. The IATA code QNS is occasionally referenced for general aviation and military charter movements linked to the base.
faqs:
Q: Is Canoas Air Force Base open to civilian passengers?
A: No, this is a military installation operated by the Brazilian Air Force. Civilian travelers should use Salgado Filho International Airport nearby instead.

Q: Where is the base located in relation to Porto Alegre?
A: It lies in the adjacent municipality of Canoas, roughly 10 km north of Porto Alegre's city center, across the Guaíba river basin.

Q: Does the base handle any scheduled commercial flights?
A: No scheduled commercial service operates from QNS; it is dedicated to military and government aircraft.

Q: Can the public visit the base?
A: Access is restricted to authorized personnel and visitors, except during occasional open-house events hosted by the Brazilian Air Force.
transport_tips: The base is best reached by car or rideshare from Porto Alegre, typically a 20-30 minute drive via the BR-116 corridor. Local buses connecting Canoas to central Porto Alegre also stop near the base perimeter. Travelers should identify themselves to security at the main gate upon arrival.
local_tip: If you happen to spot military aircraft performing touch-and-go practice runs over the Guaíba river, head to the nearby Parque Eduardo Gomes for a clear view of the approach path without entering the restricted zone.
